channel.title: Stya Yur — Writing
channel.description: A digital garden where engineering and literature grow side by side — essays, systems, marginalia and half-formed ideas, tended slowly over time.

item.title: The Architecture of Memory
item.description: We keep saying memory is like a database. It is not. Memory is architecture — it is what a mind builds to stand on.

item.title: Invisible Systems
item.description: The best software is the software you never notice. An essay on the quiet layer between intention and outcome.

item.title: Code as Prose
item.description: Source code is a form of writing addressed to two audiences at once — the machine that executes it and the human who must live with it.

item.title: In Defense of the Slow Web
item.description: Feeds optimize for the new. Gardens optimize for the true. A case for publishing like a gardener instead of a broadcaster.

item.title: Reading with Machines
item.description: What happens to reading when the margin is inhabited by an intelligence that has read everything and understood nothing?

item.title: Field Notes No. 001 — Planting Season
item.description: The first entry in a garden log. Notes on starting a digital garden, and why the metaphor is not a metaphor.
